description: This file defines the XSeries class which represents a data series along the X-axis in a chart. It provides methods to add values, clone, and serialize the series, encapsulating the underlying data elements.

classes.name: XSeries
classes.description: Represents a series of data points on the X-Axis in a chart, allowing addition of values and serialization.

classes.name: XSeries.XSeriesValues
classes.description: Encapsulates the nullable properties for XSeries, specifically the collection of XSeriesElements.

methods.name: XSeries()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the XSeries with default values.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the XSeries object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation for XSeries.

methods.name: AddBlank
methods.description: Adds a blank entry to the XSeries.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a string value to the XSeries, returning the added value.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the XSeries into a textual representation.
